title: Melbourne Parking Occupancy Dataset
description:
1.41 million half-hourly occupancy observations for 536 kerbside parking zones in Melbourne, Australia, from 18 September 2026.

The City of Melbourne publishes the current status of 6,324 in-ground parking bay sensors and keeps no history. Query the API twice and you get two snapshots; nothing tells you what the street looked like last Tuesday at 18:00. This dataset is that missing axis: a collector polls the city feed on a 30-minute grid and aggregates bays into the city's own zones.

Files. occupancy_YYYY-MM.parquet, one row per zone per 30-minute slot (time in UTC, parking_id, free_spaces, occupancy_rate); parking_zones.parquet, metadata for 536 zones with the city's zone number, street, coordinates and bay count.

Read before modelling: the median zone has 7 bays and 69 zones have one or two, so occupancy there takes only a few discrete values; 86 zones have zero variance over the whole period; no data exists between 2026-11-05 and 2026-11-12 because of a collector outage. All documented in the README.

Derived from City of Melbourne "On-street Parking Bay Sensors", licensed CC BY 4.0.
